# BillingCatalogue

The plans on sale now, to compare (plan W9). The tenant's own plan is included even when it isn't sold.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `currency` | `string` |  |
| `tiers` | [`BillingCatalogueTier`](billing-catalogue-tier.md)`[]` | Cheapest first. |

## Example

```json
{
  "currency": "...",
  "tiers": [
    {
      "terms": {},
      "priceMonthly": 0,
      "priceAnnualPerMonth": 0,
      "lanePrices": []
    }
  ]
}
```

## Where it's used

- [`billing.catalogue`](../api/billing.md) (`GET /billing/catalogue`)
